steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Hah! One more!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Jump!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Safe!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: That was a hard cliff.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Almost halfway to the top. I'll take a break here.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Is that... smoke? Why would someone start a fire out here in the middle of nowhere, in broad daylight to boot?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Could it be a distress signal?
Hard to gather firewood with my leg like this. Hope a hunter passes by and sees it...
Better be a human and not some wild beast...
Who's there?!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Don't worry, I'm just a mountain climber. I saw the smoke and thought it might be a distress signal.
Oh... thank goodness.
Someone actually came.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Is your leg hurt?
Yeah, I took a fall off a steep slope.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: What's a Sankta doing on this mountain?

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: Ah, I'm from the Notarial Hall, and I'm executing a will of the deceased.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: The instructions were to seek out a Sankta who left Laterano many years ago. I learned that he's living on one of these mountains.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: I was searching around these parts, and, well... you can guess the rest.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: The Notarial Hall sure works you hard, huh.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: You know of the Notarial Hall?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Yeah. I'm with Rhodes Island. Have you heard of it?

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: Rhodes Island—ah, Federico.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: My sympathies.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Haha. It's okay. We call him Executor, I think he's fun.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: As long as you're not on a mission with him.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: Could you help me get down the mountain?

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: I'll rest and recover in the town there before proceeding to execute the will.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: You're continuing your mission?

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Alright, grab my hand.
So the Sankta came after all.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Samara, is it? I've been wondering... you Notarial Hall people seem just as busy as our operators, always on the move.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Why do you go so far for someone who left your city?

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: The law binds us, even if they've left Laterano.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: The law...? You mean like in Kjeragandr?

spans.text: The law...? You mean like in

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: Kjeragandr? Ah, you're from Kjerag, aren't you? I should have realized.

spans.text: Ah, you're from Kjerag, aren't you? I should have realized.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Yes, faith in Kjeragandr binds the people of Kjerag together.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: Hm... there are subtle differences. From what I know, followers of Kjeragandr believe that Kjeragandr protects the people of Kjerag in subtle and mysterious ways.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: For us, our faith is in the law of Laterano itself. We believe that there is a set of rules that binds us together.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: We care for each other, understand each other, and hold ourselves accountable to each other.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: That's how the Notarial Hall came to be, because we believe that all of us have a duty to do what we can for our people.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Kjeragandr's faithful care for each other too, but we're more subtle about it, because we believe that Kjeragandr has a plan for everything.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: That's what you believe? Interesting.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: This is my first real exposure to the Kjeragandr faith. I'd love to sit down and have a chat with you, if I had the time.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: Unfortunately, I have a mission to complete, but thank you for helping me here, Ensia.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: Once I've executed this will, maybe we could catch up—

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Would you mind telling me more about the will? I might be able to help more.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: The mountains around here are steep, and dangerous for novice climbers. My mountaineering experience could be useful.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Of course, if it's classified or something, I won't push it.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: Well, there's nothing particularly confidential about it.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: Are you sure you want to do this, though?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: It's no trouble. My field assignment is already done, and I've got some time before I have to return to base.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I wouldn't be climbing here otherwise.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: In that case, I don't think I have the luxury of turning you down.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: A renowned gun-knight, Reverend Regis, passed away recently.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: In his will, he asked the Notarial Hall to find his brother, a scholar by the name of Legis, who left Laterano forty years ago after a rift between them.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: A rift?

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: It occurred so long ago that it's unlikely anyone other than the two brothers know what happened. All we know is it had something to do with conflicting views on war.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: His Holiness the Pope supported Reverend Regis's position, and Reverend Legis chose to go into exile.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: Reverend Regis knew that Reverend Legis would not return to Laterano as long as he was there, so his hope was that Legis might return after his death.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: If Reverend Legis is already...

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: He included instructions to bring back a token of Reverend Legis's, so that the brothers may be interred together.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: To reunite a pair of estranged brothers...

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I'm totally on board!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Any other details to go on?

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: I asked around and nobody had much contact with Reverend Legis, with the exception of a hunter by the name of Tiana.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: I wasn't able to find her, so I started searching the nearby mountains.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: A hunter?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Ah... that explains a lot.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: (Whisper) Maybe you didn't notice because you were injured, but we were followed.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: (Whisper) What?!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: (Whisper) I thought it was bandits looking for their mark, but now it seems likely it's the hunter you were talking about—

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: (Whisper) Head down.
Tsk.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Wait here.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I'll go after her!

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: Is there a signal here? Oh, thank goodness, I can reach one of the nearby nomadic cities.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: Executor Samara reporting in. I need assistance.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Executor
steps.text: Oh... Your Eminence?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: She's a fast climber.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: But I'm not too shabby myself!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Stop right there!
Hmph.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: You're Tiana, aren't you?
Just a hunter passing by.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Drop the act. You wouldn't have tailed us for so long if you were just passing by.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: You know why Samara is here.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: You're Sarkaz?!

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: So what if I am?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Why would a Sarkaz—

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Whoa—

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: You can move, I'll give you that.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Well, you sure can't shoot!

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: You think so?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: (Wait, she's not aiming for me.)

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: (Could it be—!)

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Too late.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Crap—!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Ouch—

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Well, this is a deep pit.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: You were luring me into a pit trap from the beginning, weren't you?

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Not just that. I also saw how good you were at mountaineering and took your climbing gear.
The Sarkaz hunter pokes her head out and shows Cliffheart her backpack.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: When did you...?

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Don't worry, I'm not going to kill you. I'll go into town and tell them to send help.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: I'll leave your backpack there. Once the rescuers arrive, take your stuff, and scram.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Why are you doing this?

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: My demands are simple.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Tell the Notarial Hall that Legis is not going back to Laterano.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I really should be more careful.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Ugh, this is a spiked cage...

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Looks like it was a beast trap, the kind that poachers use.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: But the spikes have been removed. I guess she really didn't want to kill me.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: She probably removed them, in preparation for a day like this.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: And in that case...

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: That Feline looks like she's tough enough to survive for a while.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: I'll get the old man's stuff, then report to the town.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: What a bother.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: You left enough of the trap's mechanisms for me to climb out.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: My hook's faster than your bow at this range.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Gah.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I just want to see Reverend Legis.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: He doesn't want to see you. Get lost.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Take this, then!

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Hmph—

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Look out! That rock isn't stable!

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Wha—

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Grab my hook!

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Let go! I'm too heavy!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I'm not leaving you behind!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: If I can't pull you up... brace for impact!

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Ghh—

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Are you okay?

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: You should have let go.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: You spared my life. One good turn for another.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: That's not how it works.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I didn't mean anything by it when I mentioned you were Sarkaz. I was just surprised.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: ...I don't blame you. Anyone would be.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: You might know that he has a brother—

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Regis. Let me guess, he's dead, and now he wants his brother to go back to Laterano, is that it?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: He's not going back.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: You're looking for him now? After so many decades?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: It's Reverend Regis's last wish.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Plus, no matter how big their differences, settling these differences is what family is all about.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: What makes you say that?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: My brother and sister aren't on good terms.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: B-But they're still siblings at the end of the day. All they need is the chance to open their hearts to each other.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: You're trying to convince me when you don't even sound sure yourself.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Because if I give up, we'll never sit together again as a family.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: And I know that, deep down, they care about each other.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: There's nothing you can do.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Why's that?

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Because...

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Legis is dead.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: *cough* Ugh, the dust.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: I haven't been here since he died.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: What was he to you?

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: I didn't know my parents. I was raised by a beggar in town. I guess you could call him my dad.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: The townsfolk were okay, but no one was willing to take in a Sarkaz. I started to hunt for a living, after my dad died.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: On one of those hunting trips, I ran into a big one and almost died. It was a passing Sankta who saved my life.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: He shared some meat with me and told me I couldn't shoot worth a damn.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Ha.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: I still remember... he froze for a moment when he saw me up close for the first time.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: It took me a long time to realize it was because he realized I was Sarkaz, and thought about killing me.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: But I was just a wild child who grew up in the middle of nowhere. I didn't know any of that.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: I still don't really understand it, even now.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: I had never seen a Sankta. I don't know why I should hate the halo heads. Plenty of worse people in town.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: History is complicated.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Hey, that's what the old man said. I didn't take you for a scholar.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I'll take that as a compliment.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Well, I asked him to teach me how to shoot a bow.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: But he didn't want me anywhere close. He chased me away with his gun whenever I went near.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: It's funny, now that I think about it. He probably wanted to kill me many, many times, but I didn't get that. I thought it was all fun and games.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Maybe he got tired of chasing me away, but we eventually reached a kind of understanding. I would hide near his house, and he would show a move or two, pretending not to notice me.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: What happened to him?

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: A bunch of Sarkaz bandits came three years ago. They tried to recruit me when they saw I was Sarkaz and could handle myself.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: When I refused, they kidnapped me and tried to coerce me into joining.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: The old man came to rescue me alone. I survived. He didn't.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: ...I'm sorry.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: He never considered me his student. I don't think he would've wanted a Sarkaz student.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Without the skills I learned from him, though, I would have been dead long ago.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: He never left this place, and no one ever came to look for him.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Now, his brother wants him to go back to Laterano? No way, not even if it's just his stuff.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: He doesn't belong to Laterano. He belongs to this place.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Give up and leave, if you get it. Or you can die here.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Can I take a look around?

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Suit yourself.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: What are these books?

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: The old man liked to read. He tried to teach me, but gave up when he realized I was hopeless at it.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Histories of the Sarkaz and Sankta...

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: A lot of notes and annotations...

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Hm? There's a piece of paper here.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: A letter?

a.text: Dear Regis. It is precisely because we were brothers that we were never able to come to a compromise through our empathy, for it would be insult to one another.
Was leaving the only option, though? Thinking back on it, perhaps there was a better way.
But we should not regret our choices.
Just because we made a choice does not mean the path not taken has lost its meaning.
That was why I chose to leave Laterano.
I do not think I shall ever return.
I will miss your strawberry milkshakes, though.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Look at this, Tiana.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Legis didn't hold a grudge against Regis or Laterano.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: He just made a choice, and chose not to return to Laterano because of it.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: So what?

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Either way, he doesn't want to go back to Laterano, does he?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: It's not about going back to Laterano.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: The brothers didn't have any bad blood towards one another. It's that simple.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: People believe there is no conflict between the Sankta because they share emotions through empathy.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: The reality is rather different. Sharing emotions may help you understand why the other side thinks a certain way, but it doesn't mean you must accept it.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: On minor matters, the Sankta can certainly reach a compromise through empathy.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: But there are certain things even the Sankta fail to agree upon.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: The only consensus they can reach is that they do not agree.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Who are you?!

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Velliv, Sanctae Lateranae Eccliesiae Cardinalis, Cardinal of the Holy Lateran Church.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Cardinal?!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Why—

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Reverend Gun-knight Regis was highly respected. I happened to be visiting a nearby city, and when I heard there were difficulties executing his will, I felt it was my obligation to get involved.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: I didn't expect someone else to take care of the problem before I could intervene, though.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: No need to be nervous. I overheard your conversation from outside the door. It seems everything's been resolved with a nice little bow, yes?

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Who told you—

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: The split between the gun-knight Regis and his brother, the scholar Legis, occurred over their attitude towards war.
Velliv raises her gun and points it at the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Bitch.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: I won't let you have your way, Sankta!
Tiana returns the favor, pointing her crossbow at the Sankta.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Reverend Regis and His Holiness approached war with a moderate attitude, while Reverend Legis believed in one that was more proactive and radical.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: That was the cause of the split between us.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: In his will, Reverend Regis requested the return of Reverend Legis's personal effects, in the event that Reverend Legis became deceased.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Those effects do not include a Sarkaz.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Wait!

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: This is no business for a mountaineer.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I can ask Rhodes Island to take her in!

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: If I recall correctly, Rhodes Island has a policy against interfering with a country's internal affairs.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: The extent to which that policy is followed is debatable, but I doubt they would want to get involved in this one.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I... I can send her to Kjerag!

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Kjerag?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: I hope you understand the effect that deploying the Silverash name here will have, Ensia, my child.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: You knew who I was from the very beginning, didn't you?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: I won't deny it.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: If you know my family name, then you also know my siblings.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Enya, Saintess of the Vine-Bead Court. Enciodes, CEO of Karlan Trade. It's becoming difficult to find someone who wouldn't know them.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: At the end of the day, though, just my brother and sister. My brother and sister who haven't sat down at the same table for a decade, because of a choice my brother made.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Deep down, I understand.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: It's not that my brother and sister don't understand each other, same as these two brothers.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: It's the opposite: They understand each other's position, and understand that it's not something they can move past. They understand there are certain things that only the other can do.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: That's why they'll never go back to the way they were.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I get it, but I can't give up on the idea.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I just learned that there was a pair of Sankta brothers in the same boat.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: They understood that there could be no understanding. They chose to part ways.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: But they had each other in their hearts, all the way to the very end.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: A touching tale, but what does it have to do with stopping me?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: The understanding between my brother and sister isn't about simple acceptance of the other's actions.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: The most important thing is that they believe there is something about the other's choice that's correct.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: They believe that their choice can affect the other.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Most importantly, when all is said and done, they'll stand at the same goal line.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: A fine speech, Ensia.
Velliv lowers her gun.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Why you—

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: I was just planning to scare you away and let you go. After all, I can't very well let a Sarkaz cross my line of sight and do nothing about it.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: But if Ensia has a better plan, I'm happy to go along.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: You were sure you would win and planned to spare my life from the beginning?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Did you think otherwise? Consider it an act of magnanimity, even if it might be a little hard to accept.

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: Sankta bitch...

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: As Ensia said, Reverend Regis didn't necessarily think that Reverend Legis was wrong.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: However, right versus wrong has never been the only factor in anything.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: I won't take it all, just a little token. A book, or some manuscripts. Is that acceptable?

steps.name: Sarkaz Hunter
steps.text: ...Suit yourself.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: I should say, your sincerity was touching, Ensia my child.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: You have strengthened my belief that, even though we follow different faiths and live in different environments, we still have much in common with respect to the problems we face.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I can agree with that.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I thought all Sankta were like Exusiai, but now I know there are all kinds of problems between Sankta too.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Understanding that is the first step to understanding Laterano.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: By the way, if I recall correctly, the Kjeragandr statue three years in the making is nearly complete. You should be traveling to Kjerag for the unveiling ceremony, shouldn't you?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: I could give you a ride, if you want.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Actually, I have a different request. A rather brazen one, I should say.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I would like to travel with Samara and learn more about Laterano and the Sankta. Is that okay?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Are you not planning to go back?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Not yet.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: This whole thing has given me a lot of food for thought. Maybe there's no real point trying to force them back together.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Maybe they've already sat down together while I've been away.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: If they understand each other, if both of them have Kjerag in their hearts, if they're headed for the same goal, just by different paths...

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Then I should cast my eyes forward, too.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: You came looking for me, didn't you?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Yes. I had made up my mind to come personally when I heard your name from Samara, and what the two of you talked about.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: While formal relations were established between Kjerag and Laterano at the Summit of Nations, the Kjeragandr and Lateran faiths have lacked a catalyst for dialogue.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I'll be the catalyst.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Kjerag is certainly in need of cultural dialogue, and there is no doubt that His Holiness will welcome such dialogue with open arms.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: But I must ask you again, one last time.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Do you understand what you're doing, Lady Ensia Silverash?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: In that case, I welcome you on behalf of Laterano.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Oh, but I'll need to visit the nearest Rhodes Island branch office first.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I'll need them to help me find a home for Tiana, and ask the Doctor to deliver a message to my brother.
